topicName: Đưa ra và đáp lại lời khen/chúc mừng

rules.rule: Cách đưa ra lời khen ngợi (Compliments):
rules.formula: What a/an + adj + noun! / How + adj + S + V! / You look great in... / You did a great job!
rules.examples: What a lovely dress! / How well you play the piano! / Your new haircut looks fantastic!

rules.rule: Cách đưa ra lời chúc mừng (Congratulations):
rules.formula: Congratulations on + N/V-ing! / Well done! / Happy birthday / Wishing you all the best!
rules.examples: Congratulations on passing the exam! / Well done! I'm so proud of you.

rules.rule: Cách đáp lại lời khen lịch sự và khiêm tốn:
rules.formula: Thank you. That's a nice compliment / It's very kind/nice of you to say so / Thanks, I'm glad you like it
rules.examples: - 'Your dress is beautiful.' - 'Thank you. It's very kind of you to say so.'

rules.rule: Cách đáp lại lời chúc mừng:
rules.formula: Thank you very much / Thanks! I couldn't have done it without your support
rules.examples: - 'Congratulations on winning!' - 'Thank you very much, teacher.'

rules.rule: Lưu ý tránh bẫy đề thi:
rules.formula: TRÁNH KIÊU NGẠO HOẶC CHỐI BỎ THÔ THIỂN
rules.examples: Tránh chọn: 'Yes, of course' (tự phụ), 'I know that' (bất lịch sự), 'No, I'm ugly' (tự ti thái quá). Luôn chọn phương án cảm ơn nhã nhặn.
